_doc: The RADE window's layout values (the Administrator, 2026-11-18; docs/window-design.md). Sizes are pixels at 100 % Windows scaling. engine/rade_build.py puts them into every bundle; the window never reads this file at run time. The RADE page (index.html) has its own values. logo = RADE's own logo (a PNG under assets/logo/; the window and its title-bar icon; fleet v2).
